playstation.note: Director's Cut trophy list (includes Legends Mode DLC + Iki Island). Original base-game list is NPWR15120_00.

pc.note: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut on PC supports PSN sign-in and the same trophy list as PS5.

focus_note: This crew plays Legends (multiplayer) mode primarily and has not started the single-player story yet, so 'legends' is tracked first and 'story' second.

legends.description: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is the free online co-op/PvP mode, separate from Jin's single-player story. Up to 4 classes, 5 modes: Quickplay, Story, Survival, Rivals, and the Raid/Challenge.

samurai.unlock: Available from the start (first class is free)
samurai.starting_equipment: Stone Katana, Half Bow, Basic Charm, Kunai, Smoke Bomb

skill_tree.name: Hachiman's Fury
skill_tree.description: Performs a rapid series of strikes against a group of enemies. Costs 3 Resolve.

skill_tree.name: Spirit Pull
skill_tree.description: Passively drains health from a nearby enemy while active. 36-second cooldown.

skill_tree.name: Explosive Blade
skill_tree.description: Melee attacks cause explosions on impact. 36-second cooldown.

skill_tree.name: Defender
skill_tree.description: Increases base health by 25.

skill_tree.name: Deep Strikes
skill_tree.description: Increases melee damage by 10%.

skill_tree.name: Samurai Unleashed
skill_tree.description: Reduces class ability cooldown by 15%.

skill_tree.name: Lightning Reflexes
skill_tree.description: Lets you parry incoming arrows while blocking.

skill_tree.name: Critical Defense
skill_tree.description: Widens the parry and dodge window when health is low.

skill_tree.name: Resolve Increase
skill_tree.description: Increases maximum Resolve by 1.

skill_tree.name: Heavenly Strikes
skill_tree.description: Performs an unblockable quick strike. Costs 1 Resolve.

skill_tree.name: Hachiman's Frenzy
skill_tree.description: Adds 2 extra strikes to Hachiman's Fury.

skill_tree.name: Legendary
skill_tree.description: Increases the number of Legendary items you can equip by 1.

hunter.unlock: Unlocks at Class/Player Rank 15 (3rd class unlocked, or 2nd if not Samurai)
hunter.starting_equipment: Stone Katana, Half Bow, Basic Charm, Kunai, Smoke Bomb

skill_tree.name: Eye of Uchitsune
skill_tree.description: Marks three enemies and guarantees a headshot on each.

skill_tree.name: Staggering Arrow
skill_tree.description: Shoots an arrow that stuns enemies within a small area.

skill_tree.name: Explosive Arrow
skill_tree.description: Shoots an arrow that detonates after a brief delay.

skill_tree.name: Executioner
skill_tree.description: Boosts headshot damage by 50% against targets within 12 meters.

skill_tree.name: Scent of Blood
skill_tree.description: After an assassination attempt, doubles draw and reload speed for 30 seconds.

skill_tree.name: Hunter Unleashed
skill_tree.description: Reduces class ability cooldown by 15%.

skill_tree.name: Resupply
skill_tree.description: Restores 30% of all ammo types.

skill_tree.name: Status Damage
skill_tree.description: Increases status effect damage by 25%.

skill_tree.name: Piercing Arrow
skill_tree.description: Unlocks bow arrows that can get past shields.

skill_tree.name: Pinpoint
skill_tree.description: Gives bow body shots a 50% chance to deal headshot damage.

skill_tree.name: All-Seeing Eye
skill_tree.description: Lets Eye of Uchitsune target two more enemies.

skill_tree.name: Legendary
skill_tree.description: Lets you equip one additional Legendary item.

ronin.unlock: One of the classes unlocked by leveling (see class_unlock_order note)
ronin.starting_equipment: Stone Katana, Half Bow, Basic Charm, Kunai, Smoke Bomb, Bombs

skill_tree.name: Breath of Izanami
skill_tree.description: Revives all downed allies. Costs 3 Resolve.

skill_tree.name: Spirit Animal
skill_tree.description: Summons a friendly dog companion for a short time.

skill_tree.name: Healing Incense
skill_tree.description: Places an incense pot that heals nearby allies.

skill_tree.name: Enhanced Ghost Weapons
skill_tree.description: Boosts damage from Ghost Weapons by 50%.

skill_tree.name: Weakening Burst
skill_tree.description: Weakens enemies so they deal less damage and take more.

skill_tree.name: Ronin Unleashed
skill_tree.description: Reduces class ability cooldowns by 15%.

skill_tree.name: Staggering Imposition
skill_tree.description: Increases Stagger damage by 15%.

skill_tree.name: Resolve Increase
skill_tree.description: Raises maximum Resolve by 1.

skill_tree.name: Quick Regen
skill_tree.description: Increases healing received and health regeneration by 50%.

skill_tree.name: Soothing Breath
skill_tree.description: Gives all players a heal over time for 8 seconds when Breath of Izanami is used.

skill_tree.name: Fire Breath

skill_tree.name: Legendary

assassin.unlock: Unlocks at Class/Player Rank 22 (4th and final class)
assassin.starting_equipment: Stone Katana, Half Bow, Basic Charm, Kunai, Smoke Bomb

skill_tree.name: Shadow Strike
skill_tree.description: Slips into the shadows to strike enemies from a distance.

skill_tree.name: Toxic Vanish

skill_tree.name: Assassin Unleashed

skill_tree.name: Light Step
skill_tree.description: Makes Jin silent while running.

skill_tree.name: Shadow Storm

skill_tree.name: Chain Vanish

skill_tree.name: Legendary Assassin
skill_tree.description: Increases the number of Legendary items you can equip by 1.

legends.class_unlock_order_note: Your first class is free. Additional classes unlock as your overall player level rises: a 3rd class around Rank 15, the 4th and final class around Rank 22. Exact order of which 2nd/3rd class unlocks can vary.

class_rank.description: Each class levels independently from 1 up by earning XP in missions. Rank-ups grant skill points to spend on that class's skill tree (perks above) and unlock the next class ability. Ranks of note: 1 (first class ability), 10 (second class ability), and perk unlocks at ranks 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 14, 16, and 18 (Legendary item slot).
class_rank.trophy_goal: Ultimate Warrior trophy: reach Rank 20 with all 4 classes.

ki_level.description: Your gear power level (Ki) is the average item level of your equipped Katana, Ranged weapon, Charm, and 2 Ghost Weapons. Raised by equipping higher-level gear found from missions, not by XP directly.
ki_level.gear_mastery_note: Gear Mastery (added Aug 2021) lets a Level 110 item be pushed to Level 120 by completing 5 Mastery Challenges per item (each adds +2 levels, costs 2000 Essence to activate).

quickplay.description: Drops you into an in-progress Story or Survival match via matchmaking. Split into Story Quickplay and Survival Quickplay.

story.description: 2-player co-op story missions told by the storyteller Gyozen, building toward the final antagonist Iyo. Each mission is split into 3 stages (torii gates), each with its own bonus side objectives. There are 9 story missions total; the names below are the ones confirmed by name — 3 remain unconfirmed/unnamed in our sources.
story.bonus_objectives_note: Each mission stage has 3 side objectives (Gyozen's Lost Scrolls, Oni Treasure, and a curse/challenge variant) for extra loot.

survival.description: 4-player horde mode defending a location against escalating waves of Mongols and Oni. Difficulty raises the enemy count, recommended Ki, and reward Ki.

difficulties.name: Gold
difficulties.rule: Any Ghost death fails the mission.

difficulties.name: Platinum
difficulties.rule: Any Ghost death fails the mission.

difficulties.name: Nightmare
difficulties.rule: Any Ghost death fails the mission. Weekly rotating modifier.

survival.trophy_goal: Ultimate Truth trophy: complete the final wave in a Gold Survival run.

rivals.description: 4-player (2v2) competitive PvP mode, added later as a free update alongside Gear Mastery.

raid.name: The Tale of Iyo
raid.description: The endgame Raid, the culmination of the Legends story. Requires a full team of 4 Ghosts, no matchmaking (friends only), and a minimum recommended Ki level of 100.
raid.harder_variant: Trials of Iyo - a bite-sized, harder-difficulty version of the Raid with its own leaderboards, added with the Director's Cut update.
raid.trophy_goal: Transcendence trophy: complete all 3 Raid chapters.

trophies.name: Promising Start
trophies.description: Complete a Legends Mode story mission.

trophies.name: Ultimate Truth
trophies.description: Complete the final wave in a Gold Survival run.

trophies.name: Transcendence
trophies.description: Complete all 3 Raid (Tale of Iyo) chapters.

story.description: Jin Sakai's single-player campaign. This crew hasn't started it yet - tracked here for when you do.

legend_of_the_ghost.description: Jin's single-player leveling system (separate from Legends mode's class ranks). Gained through story progress, liberating areas, and combat. Each rank gives Technique Points for the Samurai/Ghost/Stance skill trees plus passive bonuses (max health, Resolve, new Ghost Weapons).
legend_of_the_ghost.note: Sources differ on whether there are 1-2 additional intermediate ranks between Wandering Samurai and Shadow Samurai (named variously 'The People's Hope' or 'The Unyielding Wind' depending on game version). Exact XP thresholds aren't reliably documented.

story.side_content_note: Side quests (Tales of Tsushima), Mythic Tales, and collectibles (Mongol Artifacts, Hot Springs, Haiku, Inari Shrines, etc.) aren't broken out yet since the story hasn't been started - ask and this can be filled in once you're further along.

iki_island.description: Director's Cut expansion - Jin travels to Iki Island.
